thread:
maya_prod: Drafting the internal blurb for tonight's rollout (v2.4.1). Need a quick pass on exec summary, canary lane percentages, and rollback triggers. Window: 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC (60m).

maya_prod: Proposed copy:
"v2.4.1 - runtime batching + KV-cache tuning to reduce per-token cost and improve median throughput for short prompts. No user-facing changes expected.
When: 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC (60m).
Artifact: model-serving:v2.4.1 (fallback pinned to v2.4.0 and quantized variant pinned if used).
Canary: 5% @ T0 -> 30% @ T+10m -> 100% @ T+40m if health checks pass.
Watch: runtime.latency.p95, runtime.errors.rate, runtime.kv.cache_miss, infra.gpu_util.
Rollback: sustained p95 > 250ms for 10m OR errors > 2% for 5m OR SEV opened by Support."

ethan_eng: +1. One change: make middle step 30% (agree) and add a line to disable autoscaler for first 30m to keep baseline stable. Also pre-create fallback routing lane.

joanna_docs: copy nit: replace "reduce per-token cost" -> "lower per-token cost". Add a one-line Support CTA: "If customers report regressions, open a SEV and include the request id; ping #eng-oncall."

qa-bot: Staging smoke T-60: quick smoke passed, intermittent embed flake observed, scheduling full smoke at T-30. Will post status.

luca_oncall: I'll be oncall for the window. If rollback needed ping me and I'll run the rollback playbook. Confirmed runbook at /runbooks/deploys/v2.4.1-rollback.

nina_comm: I'll prepare the internal Support/CS blurb and paste it into the pinned message. Please include who-to-cc for CS lead & Support lead.

maya_prod: Updated draft per comments (autoscaler note + copy tweaks). Final checklist:
- [x] Eng review (ethan)
- [x] Docs copy (joanna)
- [ ] QA full smoke (qa-bot)
- [x] Oncall standby (luca)
- [x] infra/prep (ethan/sre)
- [x] Deploybot scheduled

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by maya_prod. Canary schedule recorded. Reminder set for T-15m.

qa-bot: Full smoke at T-30 PASS. No repro of earlier flake.

maya_prod: Posting internal announce and pinning RN in channel at T-60. Proceeding to canary at T0 unless QA fails.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% -> health OK. Next step 30% in 10m.

ethan_eng: Watching dashboards: p95 ~170ms, errors nominal, cache_miss stable.

luca_oncall: No anomalies in logs. Standing by.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 30% -> health OK. Final roll to 100% in 20m.

maya_prod: If Support opens SEV, pause rollout immediately. Otherwise proceeding to 100%.

deploy-bot: Final roll to 100% -> success. Release v2.4.1 completed and RN pinned.

maya_prod: Closing thread. Will post a short follow-up with metric deltas tomorrow. Thanks all for the quick pass.
